title: BlockchainUniversity
tagline: Complete blockchain education website from first-principles development ⚡
description: Ethereum University is a complete educational website that teaches blockchain technology from beginner to intermediate level. It's designed as a modern, interactive learning platform that makes complex blockchain concepts accessible to anyone, regardless of their technical background.
how_its_made:
Ready-to-Implement Blockchain Features:
1. Learning Progress as NFTs
Module Completion Certificates: Mint NFTs for finishing modules
Skill Badges: NFT badges for specific competencies
Learning Streaks: NFT rewards for consecutive learning days
2. Token-Gated Content
Premium Modules: Require holding education DAO tokens
Expert Access: Token holders get access to advanced content
Community Features: Governance token voting on new content
3. DeFi Integration Examples
Live Protocol Data: Real APYs, TVL, volumes from major protocols
Simulation Mode: Practice DeFi operations with fake tokens
Risk Calculator: Real-time impermanent loss and liquidation risk tools
4. DAO Governance for Education
Content Proposals: Community proposes new modules
Curriculum Voting: Token holders vote on learning priorities
Educator Rewards: Contributors earn governance tokens
